newsitem.title: USA: FULL TEXT-Providian to merge with Aegon.
newsitem.headline: FULL TEXT-Providian to merge with Aegon.

text.p: Dutch insurer Aegon N.V. and Providian Corp agreed to a merger of Providian insurance operations with Aegon USA in a deal worth $3.5 billion. Providian said the transaction is part of a reorganization which includes the spinoff of Providian Bancorp to its shareholders. A full text of Providian's press release follows.
Providian Insurance Businesses to be Merged with AEGON USA; Providian Banking Business to be Spun-off to Shareholders

LOUISVILLE, Ky., Dec. 30 /PRNewswire/ -- Providian Corporation (NYSE: PVN) announced today that its board of directors has unanimously approved a merger of its insurance operations with AEGON USA, a wholly owned subsidiary of AEGON N.V. (NYSE: AEG), in a transaction valued at $3.5 billion. The deal includes a tax-free exchange of stock of AEGON N.V. shares valued at $2.62 billion and the assumption be AEGON USA of approximately $780 million in debt and $100 million in Monthly Income Preferred Stock (MIPS).

This transaction, among the largest U.S. life insurance mergers to-date, is part of the larger strategic reorganization of Providian Corporation, which includes a spin-off of Providian Bancorp to its shareholders. As a result, the shareholders of Providian Corporation will receive one Providian Bancorp share per Providian share and AEGON common shares with a value of $28 per Providian share, subject to adjustment if the average price of AEGON common shares, determined over a specified period immediately prior to the closing, exceeds $61.153 or is less than $50.034. After a comprehensive review of strategic alternatives, management believes that this reorganization is in the best interest of shareholders. Management also believes that the tax-free structure provides benefits to shareholders in light of the low tax basis of the individual businesses.

"This combination will create an even stronger global leader in the insurance industry -- one that will enhance value for our shareholders and establish an enviable market position in an industry that is experiencing consolidation," said Irving Bailey, chairman and chief executive officer of Providian Corporation. "The creation of Bancorp as a publicly traded, independent company will expand Bancorp's growth potential." Upon completion of the transaction, Bailey will join AEGON USA as vice chairman of the board of directors.
Donald J. Shepard, chairman, president and chief executive officer of AEGON USA said:

"Providian's insurance operations are an excellent match with our own. The expansion of our traditional life insurance business, with its steady, and predictable performance, provides a solid foundation for the high growth asset accumulation and pension business we have been pursuing. The advanced technologies of the Providian units will directly complement the proven marketing success of our businesses, an advantage that both groups can leverage for mutual benefit. The strategic consolidation of two successful groups will position us well for further growth."

AEGON USA, headquartered in Baltimore, comprises four operating groups: Agency, Asset Accumulation, Health and Home Service. The separate divisions in each group operate as independent businesses targeting customers through focused marketing.

The merger of Providian's insurance businesses with AEGON is conditioned upon several events, including shareholder approval and various regulatory approvals. Closing of the transaction is expected to occur in mid-1997.

Providian Bancorp, which will become a separate publicly traded company utilizing the Providian name, has grown into one of the most profitable consumer banking operations in the country, with total managed loans of more than $9 billion. Bancorp offers credit cards, consumer loans, deposit products and other consumer banking services nationwide, using highly sophisticated direct response techniques.

Bailey added, "This transaction allows Providian Bancorp to realize its considerable potential under the leadership of Shailesh Mehta. The banking business has an excellent track record of increased earnings and receivables growth and is well positioned to take advantage of the significant market demand for its products."

Headquartered in San Francisco, Providian Bancorp's subsidiaries are First Deposit National Bank in Tilton, New Hampshire; Providian National Bank in Concord, New Hampshire; and Providian Credit Services, Inc. in Salt Lake City. For the first nine months of 1996, Providian Bancorp's pretax earnings were $163 million, up 20 percent over the same period in 1995.
Providian Corporation, with $27.3 billion in assets, is a leading provider of consumer financial services including insurance, consumer loan and annuity and pension products.

The corporation offers these and other financial services and products primarily through agents, direct-marketing media and investment professionals. Its common stock is listed on the New York and Pacific stock exchanges under the ticker symbol PVN, Providian LLC's Monthly Income Preferred Stock MIPS is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol PVN Pr M. Providian LLC is a special purpose subsidiary of Providian Corporation.

AEGON N.V., headquartered in The Netherlands, is a leading international insurance group. Ranked by market capitalization, total assets and profits, AEGON is one of the world's 10 largest listed insurance groups. Its shares are traded on the New York Stock Exchange (symbol: AEG), and the Amsterdam, Basel, Geneva, London, Tokyo and Zurich exchanges. In addition to its home country, The Netherlands, AEGON has substantial operations in the United Kingdom, Spain, Hungary and the United States, where its subsidiary, AEGON USA, is the largest non-U.S. based life insurance holding company.

AEGON N.V. was founded in 1983 through the merger of AGO (a mutual company) and Ennia. Its core business is life insurance and related pension, savings and investment products, with these businesses representing 75 percent of total revenues. The company is also active in health insurance, property and casualty insurance and banking. SOURCE Providian Corporation
